scientific_question: Is the late compact-Muon failure caused primarily by the instantaneous inability of the current Pair-VQ code chart to represent dense momentum, or by failure to transport historical code-conditioned momentum when assignments change?

causal_basis.finding: The dense path reproduces the parent and final retraction is minor. Compact momentum alignment degrades over time and Muon polar normalization preserves the resulting large angular error.

theory.dense_control: With dense next momentum B_next=mu*B+G, form H_dense=G+mu*B_next.
theory.instantaneous_chart_control: Under the current pre-step codes, average and expand the actual dense B_next to form P_t B_next, then H_chart=G+mu*P_t B_next. This has the current chart capacity but no compact historical-state error.
theory.historical_compact_control: Update the production code-conditioned compact buffer from the identical G under the identical current codes, expand it, and form H_compact=G+mu*ExpandedCompact_next.
theory.subspace_component: H_chart-H_dense measures instantaneous current-code representational error.
theory.transport_component: H_compact-H_chart measures historical compact-state evolution and chart-transport error.
theory.polar_requirement: Compare all three controls both before and after the identical Newton--Schulz Muon polar map because pre-polar angle alone is not predictive.

frozen_protocol.parent: exact 124M QK-only BlockFHT attention plus dense MLP parent, seed 1337, LR 0.0024, 238 updates
frozen_protocol.compact_family: production full-MLP Pair-VQ assignments and code-conditioned momentum from the failed forward-visible endpoint family
frozen_protocol.gradient_source: the exact clipped dense-parent gradient before its Muon update
frozen_protocol.code_source: the current nonintervening teacher-forced Pair-VQ shadow assignments before the dense optimizer step

per_matrix: relative error, cosine, and positive-line energy recovery for dense versus chart and dense versus historical compact before polar
chart versus historical compact before and after polar
aggregate: energy-weighted all-matrix, c_fc, and c_proj metrics
exact squared-error decomposition with cross term for current-chart subspace versus historical transport components

classification_gate.instantaneous_code_subspace_primary_if: At both late probes, post-polar chart-versus-dense squared error exceeds transport squared error and is at least 70 percent of historical-compact-versus-dense squared error.
classification_gate.historical_transport_primary_if: At both late probes, post-polar historical-compact-versus-chart squared error exceeds chart-versus-dense squared error and is at least 70 percent of historical-compact-versus-dense squared error.
classification_gate.mixed_or_unresolved_if: Neither component reaches the frozen 70 percent threshold at both late probes.

decision_rule.instantaneous_code_subspace_primary: Authorize theory and a no-training representation oracle for a low-bit block-scaled momentum tangent with temporal error feedback. Do not authorize an LM endpoint.
decision_rule.historical_transport_primary: Authorize implementation and exact-config MFU gating of codebook-momentum transport across assignment refresh with no new persistent state. Do not authorize a scale-up or horizon transfer.
decision_rule.mixed_or_unresolved: Stop Pair-VQ endpoint trials and derive a joint chart/state model before any new training run.

execution_gate.watchdog_callbacks: terminal/error-only because the replay is expected within one to two hours
